objective: Implement server-persisted online message queuing, native Codex steering and bound conversation continuation after pulling remote updates.
behavior: Queue/steer/auto delivery intent; original execution and history remain under command idempotency. Both SSE and WebSocket share admission.
Queued payloads survive stop/disconnect/restart. Explicit resume loads original payload; failed/unknown tasks never automatically reexecute. Stop only cancels the active turn.
Native turn/steer uses server-owned expectedTurnId, serialized writes and one stdout reader with per-request acknowledgement; delivery acceptance is not task completion.

Codex queued turns use thread/start(ephemeral=false) then thread/resume. Binding includes project, selected references/scopes/skills, workspace, model/profile and sandbox permissions; changed selections isolate old context.
Owner/project/model authorization rechecked; queued input and native thread identifiers remain server-owned; goals and legacy ephemeral requests keep their existing protocol.
